_help: Copy to settings\loop\<name>.json. presets = names of your saved settings (the Saved Settings list). per_round = pictures per setting per round (1-8). Stops at stop_at (HH:MM), after max_hours, after rounds (0 = no limit), or when a file named STOP appears in the run folder. card = a character card whose identity scores the faces (optional). polish = a Polish choice to force (e.g. Auto), empty = what each saved setting has. gate.block_tags / artifact_tags = WD14 tags that reject a picture; park_after = rounds with no keeper before a setting is parked.
